## Context

Describe the situation, forces, and constraints that led to this
decision. Explain the problem to be solved and why a decision is needed
now. Include any technical, operational, or organizational context
relevant to understanding the decision.

## Decision

State the decision clearly and concisely. Begin with a verb: "Use...",
"Adopt...", "Implement...", "Reject...". This section must stand alone
as a complete statement of what was decided.

---

- Why it was rejected
